title: 💻 Multiple IT Openings in Summit County, OH - Up to $170K+ - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Summit County’s tech scene is buzzing this month, with several solid openings for both early‑career and seasoned IT pros. From data analytics to data center operations, there’s something for every skill level.
Data Analyst – Intern Employer: Etactics
Location: Hudson, OH
Type: Internship
A great hands‑on start for anyone looking to build data skills. You’ll help create dashboards and track key performance metrics while learning AWS QuickSight and data visualization basics.
OMS Applications Lead Employer: TRC Companies, Inc.
Location: Akron, OH
Type: Full‑Time
Salary: $87,984 – $174,866 per year
Lead outage management system projects for major utilities. This senior role blends IT and engineering, with travel opportunities and a strong benefits package.
Data Centre Operations Engineer Employer: N Consulting Global
Location: Twinsburg, OH
Type: Full‑Time
Support 24/7 data center operations—installing, troubleshooting, and maintaining critical hardware and cabling. Ideal for those with 2–6 years of hands‑on experience in enterprise environments.
(Also listed as “Datacenter Technician” by the same employer—same core duties.)
